record.body: Durable learning: independently-qualified sensor generations must own disjoint immutable identity ranges; historical courts qualify their own tranche, never the unbounded future query set. Project-memory proxy failures are evidence: malformed requests must preserve BUILD_BROKEN receipts and be superseded by a new exact-head bounded request, never overwritten. Weakest multiplier observed from Project memory was consumer replication; R45B therefore made realized cross-repository replication yield observable with sensors 136..185. Exact final default=be81dd42c8eae76b571b6e0b43951ee52b061367; exact R45B head=6dc67c421c7b2e8498df581a46ecc9e30202cab3; direct merge containment proven.
